services.name: Surf Charters
services.desc: We specialize in putting you on Snook, Redfish, Tarpon, Cobia, Snapper, Flounder, and other fun-fighting, good-eating species known to call Florida’s waters home. We offer full-service charters for any level of angler, from beginner to advanced. So, whether you’re looking for a family-friendly day or Hell on water,

explain.meaning: Fishing with weighted lines dropped to the sea floor.
Fishing a few miles off the beach, between inshore and offshore.
Fishing in calm bays and near the coast, usually in sight of land.

blurb: Guests can fish for various species including Snook, Redfish, Tarpon, and more. Surf charters offer optimized wave count and comfort on a stocked boat. Eco-tours explore the Indian River Lagoon wildlife and islands, and snorkeling charters provide gear to explore shipwrecks and reefs.
